quarterly_data.quarter: MaxLinear press release: MaxLinear Introduces Topaz, One of the Industry's Most (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: MaxLinear announced Topaz, a PON Home Gateway Unit (HGU) SoC it calls one of the industry's most advanced, for 10G broadband deployments: it integrates fiber access, packet processing, AI/ML acceleration, post-quantum cryptography (PQC) readiness and power management on one chip, with high-speed 25G and 50G connectivity, DDR5 memory support and Wi-Fi 8 readiness, for PON fiber gateways, Ethernet and Fixed Wireless Access. Topaz shares a common software and hardware foundation with MaxLinear's Puma 9 DOCSIS platform (AnyWAN). The release says select OEMs are already designing next-generation gateways with Topaz; Askey CEO Robert Lin said Askey is an early access partner and looks forward to incorporating Topaz in its roadmap, and Gemtek Technology CEO James Lee said Gemtek is excited to work with MaxLinear and leverage Topaz. Puneet Sethi, SVP and GM, Network Infrastructure and Carrier: Topaz delivers affordable 10G PON connectivity today. No availability date or volumes stated.
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: gateway OEMs: Askey early access partner, Gemtek working with MaxLinear on Topaz
